summary: KPG23D.EXE 1.01 traced in QEMU (serial_write/read/update_parameters) and driven to 'Done Reading' against a simulated radio: 4800 8N2, MCR never written (DTR/RTS off), 6-byte identity not checked, W <addr> 80 + 128 bytes with 06/06, no Z, no exit command. 2026-11-13 notes recorded the BIOS's boot-time 9600 8N1; NewChirp's 9600 8N1 with DTR/RTS on explains why no TK-350 ever answered
